_comment: Best-effort generic attribute set for relisting against an EXISTING ASIN (相乗り出品). Amazon validates attributes per product_type via the Product Type Definitions API, so some categories will require additional fields (e.g. item_name, bullet_point, recommended_browse_nodes) even when the ASIN already exists. Run `python -m amazon_auto_listing.cli inspect-schema --product-type <TYPE>` once you have real credentials to see the exact required schema for your category, then extend/duplicate this file as templates/<PRODUCT_TYPE>.json.
